Description: Graphic Bottle Shoppe will be a niche and specialty bottle shoppe that will bring a retail selection of quality crafted and independent wine and beer, as well as a rotating coffee and tea selection. Alongside an emphasis on retail sales, GBS will also offer on-premise availability so customers can enjoy any beverage provided on the spot. To complement beverages, GBS will offer food services and quality goods provided by local producers. GBS will showcase rotating local crafts and goods from other small businesses to support the surrounding community and create a dynamic and exciting atmosphere. In order to really create an atmosphere to make customers feel comfortable and welcome to learn about our products, there will be a small production comic book/graphic novel section to help soften the pretense around wine and beer. Graphic Bottle Shoppe truly will bring a refreshing and unique experience to the Bay Area that can be suitable for anyone. With an extensive professional history in beer and wine, Jackson and Kristina will provide customers with service featuring a comprehensive knowledge on all products, offering a unique shopping experience for beverages and unique finds.
